:::{#def-leverage}
#### Leverage

Consider a linear model fitted by [ordinary least squares](correlation-regression.qmd#def-ols),
with [term vectors](#def-term-vector) $\termvec{\iobs}$, $\iobs \in \obsidx$,
and an invertible [cross-product matrix](#def-cross-product-matrix) $\sscp$.
The **leverage** of observation $\iobs$ is

$$
\lev{\iobs} \eqdef \tp{\termvec{\iobs}} \sscp^{-1} \termvec{\iobs}.
$$ {#eq-leverage}

:::

:::{#rem-source-leverage}
#### Source: Leverage

@james2021islr2e [sec. 3.3.3],
written here with term vectors and the matrix $\sscp$,
as in [the vector form of the OLS estimates](correlation-regression.qmd#thm-ols-slr-vector).

:::
